annotations.title: Check a payment file before it goes to the bank (free, up to 25 payments)

description: Free. Use before a payment run is sent to the bank: give the payment file as text (SEPA pain.001 XML or CSV with payee name and IBAN) and, best, last run's file or a vendor list as previous. Each line gets release, review or hold: invalid or changed IBAN, a payee name that imitates a known supplier, one IBAN under two names, new payee, duplicate, possible sanctions match. Up to 25 payments here; 100 with an API key over HTTP.

file.description: The payment file content: pain.001 XML or CSV

previous.description: Last run's file or a vendor list (name, IBAN)
